desc: The Load It/Shoot It/Clean It Kit comes with everything you need. The kit includes: Traditions DVDEZ Clean Solvent, Bullet starter with jag, Loading and cleaning jag that doubles as a ramrod extension, 209/Musket capper, Bore brush, Magnum quick loaders, Breech plug grease, Cleaning patches (40 pcs), Season patches (25 pcs), Smackdown SST 250 grain bullets, EZ Load sabots and Ammo tubes with caps (2).
